source: World of Darkness Character Profiling & Tenure Engine: Master Data Blueprints
governance: CHRONICLE SPATIAL ENGINE: MASTER SPECIFICATION & ARCHITECTURE GOVERNANCE

prototypes.temporalAnchor: The Digital Footprint: Keeps an un-updated, anonymous burner account to spy on their living sister’s social media.
prototypes.traumaticCatalyst: The First Feeding Breach: Lost control in a target’s apartment. The clan elder covered it up but executed the victim's roommate to enforce silence.
prototypes.aestheticAndTell: High-End Camouflage: Impeccable tailoring; skin looks waxy and cold under lights. Pupils do not dilate in darkness.
prototypes.attitudeAndPhobia:
Frigid, predatory intellectualism.
Phobia: Pyrophobia (Extreme terror of open flames or disposable lighters).
prototypes.secretActivePlot: Using corporate shells to purchase rival havens and evict the occupants via mundane municipal eminent domain laws.
prototypes.fatalWeakness: Mortal Dependent: Has an aging mortal child in a local nursing facility who believes their parent died decades ago.

prototypes.temporalAnchor: The Old Truck: A rusted '98 flatbed with a glovebox full of unpaid civilian parking tickets from their previous life.
prototypes.traumaticCatalyst: The Kinfolk Betrayal: Watched their childhood hometown woodland bulldozed under a corporate developer's contract signed by their own uncle.
prototypes.aestheticAndTell: Street Radical: Heavy leather motorcycle jacket over a patched hoodie. Smells faintly of swamp water and copper ozone.
prototypes.attitudeAndPhobia:
Aggressive, territorial hyper-vigilance.
Phobia: Enclosed cages / cell confinement.
prototypes.secretActivePlot: Siphoning commercial power grids to build a secret, unmonitored mesh-network across subterranean tunnels for outcasts.
prototypes.fatalWeakness: Silver Vulnerability: Carries a piece of buckshot lodged near their spine that cannot be removed without risking motor function.

prototypes.temporalAnchor: The Dial-Up Modem: A custom-modified 56k US Robotics card that serves as a focus for digital sensory scrying.
prototypes.traumaticCatalyst: The Paradox Collapse: A vulgar casting attempt caused a localized space-time fold that pulled their research partner permanently into the Horizon.
prototypes.aestheticAndTell: Academic Recluse: Tweed coat covered in chalk dust. Fingertips are permanently stained black from chemical ink formulations.
prototypes.attitudeAndPhobia:
Defensive intellectualism, easily agitated.
Phobia: Psychometry targets (Terrified of touching items with strong history).
prototypes.secretActivePlot: Infiltrating municipal archives to delete records of an anomalous geographic survey that maps localized ley lines.
prototypes.fatalWeakness: Paradox Flaw: If they cast magic vulgarly, all digital screens within 20 feet flicker into unreadable static for an hour.

prototypes.temporalAnchor: The Letters: A stack of unread, water-damaged deployment letters hidden beneath the floorboards of an old post office.
prototypes.traumaticCatalyst: The Nihil Fall: Their original mortal anchor was destroyed by an arson fire, dragging them through the Tempest before they reconstituted.
prototypes.aestheticAndTell: The Pale Passenger: Tattered, translucent rain coat. Shadows do not move in perfect alignment with their body.
prototypes.attitudeAndPhobia:
Hollow, quiet melancholy, whispers when speaking.
Phobia: High industrial noise / factories.
prototypes.secretActivePlot: Attempting to possess a local politician to prevent the demolition of an old theater that houses a cross-Veil portal.
prototypes.fatalWeakness: Stygian Chain: Can be anchor-bound or severely weakened by old iron artifacts forged prior to the twentieth century.

prototypes.temporalAnchor: The Sketchbook: A charcoal sketchbook containing continuous drawings of an imaginary castle that doesn't exist in the Autumn world.
prototypes.traumaticCatalyst: The Banality Incursion: Forced onto heavily prescribed psychiatric stabilizing medication by parents, temporarily deadening their connection to the Dreaming.
prototypes.aestheticAndTell: Neon Romantic: Wearing bright, mismatching thrift clothes. Eyes look overly bright, reflective like a cat's in shadow.
prototypes.attitudeAndPhobia:
Manic enthusiasm masking deep despair.
Phobia: Complete isolation / dark sensory deprivation tanks.
prototypes.secretActivePlot: Stalking an avant-garde artist to steal their paintings before they can be sold to boring, uninspired public corporate collections.
prototypes.fatalWeakness: Iron Vulnerability: Coming into direct physical contact with cold iron causes immediate physical burns and strips away fairy glamour.

prototypes.temporalAnchor: The Vinyl Collection: First-pressing underground punk records stored in an old milk crate; refuses to listen to digital music format.
prototypes.traumaticCatalyst: The Elysium Purge: Framed by a Ventrue Archon for a blood-theft conspiracy; barely escaped the Prince's executioners by burning a haven.
prototypes.aestheticAndTell: The Night Clerk: Cheap linen suit, heavy dark sunglasses worn indoors, smells strongly of embalming chemicals.
prototypes.attitudeAndPhobia:
Distanced, clinical, speaks with absolute monotony.
Phobia: Mirror surfaces (Refuses to look at reflections).
prototypes.secretActivePlot: Mutilating hospital organ transport logs to harvest fresh blood profiles without alerting the Prince's Scourge.
prototypes.fatalWeakness: Blood Addiction: Can only draw nourishment from individuals suffering from terminal, painful illnesses.

prototypes.temporalAnchor: The Military Dog Tags: Belonged to an army sergeant they accidentally killed during their first violent, unmitigated frenzy.
prototypes.traumaticCatalyst: The Hive Raid: Lost an entire pack during a desperate assault against an underground corporate laboratory owned by Magadon Pharmaceuticals.
prototypes.aestheticAndTell: The Eco-Saboteur: Tactical hiking gear caked in grey canal grease. Fingernails are cracked and jagged.
prototypes.attitudeAndPhobia:
Sullen, volatile explosive anger.
Phobia: Heavy machinery hum / automated drone flights.
prototypes.secretActivePlot: Planting toxic chemical contaminants inside the server cooling loops of a corporate building to flush out digital spirits.
prototypes.fatalWeakness: Moon Bond: During a new moon, their physical senses are drastically impaired, leaving them vulnerable to ambush.

prototypes.temporalAnchor: The Iron Inkwell: A hand-forged inkwell containing iron-gall ink. Refuses to document any true occult research on magnetic media.
prototypes.traumaticCatalyst: The Technocratic Pogrom: Their original Chantry house in London was targeted and leveled by a targeted electrical grid firebombing campaign in 1894.
prototypes.aestheticAndTell: The Digital Occultist: Black turtleneck, titanium frame glasses. Fingers tap in rhythmic patterns on table surfaces.
prototypes.attitudeAndPhobia:
Arrogant, dismissive superiority complex.
Phobia: Traditional religious imagery or sacred spaces.
prototypes.secretActivePlot: Binding minor spirits into localized cryptographic software files to automate defensive wards on their server stacks.
prototypes.fatalWeakness: True Name Vulnerability: A rival cabal has an un-redacted copy of their birth certificate and true childhood name.

prototypes.temporalAnchor: The Pocket Watch: A silver-plated timepiece stopped exactly at 4:13 PM, the precise moment of their battlefield demise.
prototypes.traumaticCatalyst: The Spectre Chase: Tracked through the Labyrinth by their own shadow-self for forty straight years before emerging back into the Shadowlands.
prototypes.aestheticAndTell: The Forgotten Worker: Heavy grease-stained overalls. They leave faint, wet footprints that evaporate within seconds.
prototypes.attitudeAndPhobia:
Resigned, protective of children on their route.
Phobia: Incinerators / bright furnaces.
prototypes.secretActivePlot: Haunting a shipping dock warehouse to manipulate logistics manifests, ensuring an occult artifact remains lost at sea.
prototypes.fatalWeakness: Regret Anchor: Cannot physically cross running water unless carrying a item of clothing worn on the day of their death.

prototypes.temporalAnchor: The Cassette Tape: A distorted, demagnetized mixtape of a garage band whose members have all long since succumbed to Banality.
prototypes.traumaticCatalyst: The Unweaving: Witnessed their first true mentor completely forget their fae heritage, converting into a mundane, clock-punching accountant.
prototypes.aestheticAndTell: The Goth Street Busker: Velvet coat, carrying an old acoustic violin. Skin is remarkably flawless, almost unnatural.
prototypes.attitudeAndPhobia:
Mocking, dramatic, mercurial personality shifts.
Phobia: Clockwork ticks / metronomes.
prototypes.secretActivePlot: Using glamoured street performances to siphon creative energy from young runaways to delay their own winter regression.
prototypes.fatalWeakness: Oathbound: Is physically incapable of speaking an untruth if addressed by their full, official court title.

pressureVariants.title: Quiet Observation
pressureVariants.effect: A hidden watcher records the group without acting.
pressureVariants.mechanicalSeed: Identify the observer before the next scene.

pressureVariants.title: Municipal Intervention
pressureVariants.effect: Permits, inspections, closures, or code enforcement threaten the arrangement.
pressureVariants.mechanicalSeed: A mundane deadline advances whenever attention rises.

pressureVariants.title: Faction Challenge
pressureVariants.effect: A rival faction makes a deniable territorial claim.
pressureVariants.mechanicalSeed: The first overt power use changes local influence.

pressureVariants.title: Human Witness
pressureVariants.effect: A civilian has noticed the pattern and is collecting evidence.
pressureVariants.mechanicalSeed: The witness can become an asset, liability, or dependent.

pressureVariants.title: Corporate Acquisition
pressureVariants.effect: A shell company is buying, demolishing, or securitizing the site.
pressureVariants.mechanicalSeed: Trace ownership to reveal the supernatural beneficiary.

pressureVariants.title: Spiritual Disturbance
pressureVariants.effect: The Gauntlet, Dreaming, Shadow, resonance, or occult geometry destabilizes.
pressureVariants.mechanicalSeed: Add one environmental manifestation per unresolved scene.

pressureVariants.title: Internal Betrayal
pressureVariants.effect: Someone inside the controlling group trades access for protection.
